scripts.reset: node --env-file=../backend/.env.test -e "fetch('http://localhost:' + (process.env.API_PORT ?? '3001') + '/test/reset', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'x-test-reset-token': process.env.TEST_RESET_TOKEN ?? '' } }).then(r => console.log(r.status === 200 ?
